energyStars.label: Send energy to rekordbox as Rating
energyStars.helpOff: Each send will set Rating in rekordbox from your tracks' energy (1 and 2 are one star, up to 9 and 10 for five)
energyStars.helpOn: Each send sets Rating in rekordbox from your tracks' energy (1 and 2 are one star, up to 9 and 10 for five). Tracks with no energy keep their stars.
energyStars.offNote: Stars in rekordbox stay as last sent. Your Library's rating follows rekordbox again.
energyStars.confirmTitle: Send energy to rekordbox as Rating?
energyStars.changes_zero: No stars in rekordbox would change (export read {{when}})
energyStars.changes_one: {{count, number}} track's stars in rekordbox would change (export read {{when}})
energyStars.changes_other: {{count, number}} tracks' stars in rekordbox would change (export read {{when}})
energyStars.noRead: Can't count yet (no rekordbox export read). The send checklist shows the number before anything is written.
energyStars.confirmDetail: Tracks with no energy keep their stars. If you change a Rating in rekordbox later, you'll choose which to keep in Review under Conflicts. Turning this off later stops the sending, but stars already sent stay in rekordbox.
energyStars.error: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.
energyStars.countError: Couldn't count the tracks. Try again.

error.notOurs: This file isn't a bundle from this app.
error.tooLarge: This bundle is too large to open.
error.damaged: This bundle is damaged, so it can't be used.
error.newer: This bundle comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app, then try again.
error.nothingStaged: There's no bundle or backup ready to use. Choose it again.
error.backupNotFound: That backup is no longer there.

bundle.title: Move to another computer
bundle.intro: Make a bundle of your Library (crates, playlists, tags, history and settings) to open on another computer of yours. The music itself isn't in it: copy your music yourself, and the app finds it again by drive and folder.
bundle.creating: Making the bundle. A big Library can take a few minutes.
bundle.notSaved: Not saved. The app keeps no copy outside its own folder.

confirm.importTitle: Replace this computer's Library with this bundle?
confirm.restoreTitle: Replace this computer's Library with this backup?
confirm.made: Made on {{date}} by version {{version}} of the app
confirm.detail: This replaces everything in this computer's Library with what is in the bundle. Your current Library is kept as a backup first, so you can restore it. The app restarts to finish.
confirm.machine: Online services start off, and the rekordbox file you chose is forgotten; turn them on or choose the file again here.
confirm.drives: Music folders on drives that aren't connected show as missing. Connect the drive, or use “Find it…” on the folder in Music folders.

backups.title: Backups
backups.empty: No backups yet. One is kept each time a Library is replaced.

save.notABundle: The bundle to save isn't one this app made.
save.exists: A file with that name is already there. Nothing was replaced; choose a new name.
save.folderMissing: That folder isn't there. Choose another.
save.folderNotPlain: Save in an ordinary folder, not a shortcut or link.
save.inMusicFolder: That is inside one of your music folders. Choose a place outside them.
save.inAppData: That is inside this app's own folder. Choose another place.
save.gigStick: That drive looks like a rekordbox gig stick. Choose a place on another drive.
save.inRekordboxFolder: That is inside rekordbox's own folder. Choose another place.
